name: Romantic Meetup
source:
This story is about Anna, a university student who loves studying but rarely goes out to have fun, one day her friend Tina invited her to the bar to have a lot of fun! Anna was preparing for the exam, but since she rarely goes out with her best friend, she agreed!

Anna also has a good friend called Gregory, who she invited because he is entertaining on every occasion! 

Let's see what this night will promise for our protagonist!

[From [url=https://remytaxidicolore.itch.io/romantic-meetup]itch.io[/url]]
